resources.string: No data, no signup. Scan any UPI QR and pay over the *99# mobile-network rail — the bank menu shown here as clean steps, not a raw dialer screen.
Your UPI PIN is never seen or stored by UrgentPay. At the moment it\'s needed, we hand off to your phone\'s secure NPCI screen — the only place a UPI PIN should ever be typed.

UrgentPay is an independent utility. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to NPCI, UPI, BHIM, or any bank. Payments are completed by your bank over the *99# / IVR telecom rails. Availability depends on your bank and SIM — no app can guarantee a transfer.
Works fully offline. We read the recipient\'s UPI ID and amount from the code — no typing.
Check who you\'re paying and the amount. We run *99# in the background and show the bank\'s reply here.
The secure NPCI PIN screen opens for the final approval. Done — no internet used at any step.
For the final approval, your bank\'s secure UPI PIN screen opens. UrgentPay never handles your PIN.
Always verify the recipient before approving. Sending money cannot be undone.
Enter UPI PIN in secure dialer
This device can\'t run *99# inside the app. Opening the secure dialer with *99# instead.
The mobile network ended the session. You can retry from the secure dialer.
Enter a valid UPI ID or 10-digit mobile number.
Phone permission is needed to run the offline payment rail. You can also use the secure dialer.
